command:
set -euo pipefail
    export PATH="/home/ljl/research-systems/vllm/.venv/bin:$PATH"
    export PYTHONPATH=/home/ljl/research-systems/vllm-reproduction-e450367
    export VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE=1
    export no_proxy=127.0.0.1,localhost
    export NO_PROXY=127.0.0.1,localhost
    /home/ljl/research-systems/vllm/.venv/bin/python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
      --model "$LLM_SWITCH_BENCH_MODEL_PATH" \
      --served-model-name "$LLM_SWITCH_BENCH_MODEL_NAME" \
      --host 127.0.0.1 \
      --port 19700 \
      --enable-sleep-mode \
      --gpu-memory-utilization 0.80 \
      --max-model-len 1024 \
      --dtype half \
      --enforce-eager &
    server_pid=$!
    trap 'kill -TERM "$server_pid" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$server_pid" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
    /home/ljl/research-systems/vllm/.venv/bin/python \
      -m llm_switch_bench.experiments.exact_disk.lifecycle_driver \
      --base-url http://127.0.0.1:19700 \
      --served-model-name "$LLM_SWITCH_BENCH_MODEL_NAME" \
      --ready-timeout-s 360 \
      --cycles 6
    mkdir -p "$LLM_SWITCH_BENCH_OUT_DIR/runtime-bundle"
    cp -a "$VLLM_EXACT_DISK_BACKUP_DIR"/. "$LLM_SWITCH_BENCH_OUT_DIR/runtime-bundle"/
